# starrydata-mcp

> An MCP server that lets AI agents search and retrieve digitized materials-science data (papers, samples, and measured property curves — thermoelectric, battery, magnetic, dielectric materials) from [Starrydata2](https://starrydata.nims.go.jp/)'s publicly distributed dataset (CC BY 4.0), via a local DuckDB replica refreshed daily from public snapshots — no connection to Starrydata's production database or API.

Status: pre-release, under active development.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): install, quick start, the 8 MCP tools, data source and license
- [Technical overview (Japanese)](docs/TECHNICAL_OVERVIEW.md): full architecture, design rationale, real bugs found and fixed, test strategy
- [Architecture design doc](docs/design/architecture.md): original design — dataset investigation, DuckDB schema, MCP tool spec, clean-architecture layering

## Using it

```sh
starrydata-mcp ingest   # download the latest public dataset snapshot and build the local DuckDB file (15-30 min on a full run)
starrydata-mcp serve    # start the MCP server (stdio)
```

Register `starrydata-mcp serve` as an MCP server in an agent's config (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, etc.).

## Tools

Eight MCP tools follow a search → narrow → fetch pattern (lightweight summaries first, full data points only on request): `search_materials`, `get_sample_detail`, `list_properties`, `search_curves`, `get_curve_data`, `search_papers`, `get_paper_detail`, `get_dataset_info`. Full parameter reference in the README.

## License

Code: MIT. Data served: CC BY 4.0 — see the README's "Data citation" section for the citation required when using the data.
